evidence_snippets: Global and multi-regional endpoints Cloud Translation - Advanced offers a global endpoint as well as EU and US multi-regional endpoints: translate.googleapis.com (global) translate-eu.googleapis.com translate-us.googleapis.com If you use a multi-regional endpoint, your data at-rest and machine learning processing stays within the continental boundaries of the EU or US.

Global versus multi-regional endpoints When using a multi-regional endpoint, there are some difference when compared to using the global endpoint: Text translations that use custom AutoML models are not supported.
